::: {#exm-connected-edges}
#### Counting edges instead of looking for cycles

- The town graph (@exm-spanning-tree) has 7 vertices,
  so a connected subgraph with all seven towns has at least 6 edges, by @cor-connected-edges,
  as @sol-fewest-roads found.
- The pipes graph $P$ of @exm-pipes-tree is connected and has 7 vertices and 6 edges.
  By @cor-connected-edges it is a tree, without taking out any vertices.

:::
